newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sinora surges on speculative play.
newsitem.headline: Sinora surges on speculative play.

text.p: Malaysian timber firm Sinora Industries Bhd surged in heavy volume on speculative buying, dealers and analysts said.
At 0808 GMT, the stock was up 70 cents or 10.37 percent to 77.45 ringgit on volume of 11.2 million shares traded, the most actively traded stock in late-afternoon trade.
"There's no story. It's just a play," said a retail dealer at Mayban Securities.
Officials at Sinora were not could not be immediately reached for comment.
They said a number of speculative stocks which were hit in the market's recent skid following the drop of the ringgit were making a comeback.
"It's pure syndicate play. This has been a favourite punter's stock like others which are coming back," said a dealer at a Malaysian brokerage.
